transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... ever since I tried to turn my art into a real freelance business, things have just been really hard. I keep getting so wound up over things like invoices and client messages. I just get stressed and avoid them until I'm, you know, crying at my kitchen table, or I end up forgetting normal stuff like paying my own bills. It's just getting to be too much.

Did these feelings of stress and being overwhelmed start around the time you began freelancing, or had you noticed similar difficulties with anxiety or focus even before that, going further back in your life?

No, it really just started when I began the freelance stuff. I mean, I've never really had trouble with anxiety or focusing before this. It was only after I tried to turn my art into an actual business that all this stress started happening. Before that, I was always doing fine.
How many months ago did you start trying to turn your art into a freelance business?

I started trying to do the freelance stuff about three months ago, but... the really bad stress, where I get so overwhelmed and just avoid everything, that didn't start right away. It was more like... a month after I took on this community arts contract and really tried to make the business more formal. That's when it all hit me.
Aside from the stress around the business tasks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy—like your art itself—most of the day, nearly every day?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel sad or down most of the time. I still like making art when I'm just doing it for fun and not thinking about the business side of it. It's really just the stress from all the freelance stuff that's getting to me. I haven't lost interest in the things I normally enjoy.
Aside from the stress related to your freelance business tasks, do you find yourself worrying excessively about other areas of your life, like your health, relationships, or finances in general?

No, not really. I mean, I worry a little bit about money since I'm trying to make this business work, but it's not like a constant, overwhelming worry about everything else. My health and relationships are fine. It's really just the business stuff that's stressing me out.
